meta.title: Implement lazy loading for RegistryInstance to improve latency in operations where the registry does not need to be read
meta.body_summary: Refactor RegistryInstance to use lazy loading via mutable struct and getproperty, deferring decompression and Registry.toml parsing until first access, with before/after benchmark showing Pkg.instantiate() latency drop from 0.390s to 0.162s and allocation reduction from 148MB to 28MB.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code refactored RegistryInstance to lazy load fields; before/after benchmark shows ~58% latency reduction and ~81% allocation reduction; merged in ~11h without review text.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 88 changed lines in a single file, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, fast-turnaround performance PR and is consistent with the low-friction merge.

review_details.concern_detail: No review or comment text exists in the dataset; the PR was merged without any recorded human feedback.
review_details.performance_claim: Lazy loading RegistryInstance reduces Pkg.instantiate() latency from 0.390s to 0.162s and allocations from 148MB to 28MB.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Lazy loading is a straightforward optimization within a single struct; Claude_Code produced a change with self-contained benchmark evidence and no review friction.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides exact @time output before and after, including allocations and gc time; no external repro steps needed beyond running Pkg.instantiate().
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression handling needed; PR merged without issues.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored src/Registry/registry_instance.jl to change RegistryInstance from immutable struct with eager field loading to mutable struct with lazy loading; expensive operations (decompression, Registry.toml parsing) deferred until getproperty triggers ensure_registry_loaded!().
change_trajectory: Single commit rewriting RegistryInstance struct with lazy loading and getproperty overload.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with single commit by KristofferC (Claude Code author); no review comments; merged after ~11 hours by same user.
